test_title: PYST 9: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following platforms will provide training to the new recruits inducted during the 15th edition of the Rozgar Mela in April 2025, apart from formal skill programmes?
solution: The correct answer is __**iGOT Karmayogi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **iGOT Karmayogi** is an online learning platform under the **National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building (NPCSCB)**, launched by the Government of India. • The platform is designed to provide continuous learning and capacity-building opportunities to government employees, including newly inducted recruits. • It aims to help civil servants acquire **role-specific competencies** and focuses on a comprehensive approach toward skill development. • iGOT Karmayogi offers **self-paced learning modules**, interactive content, and assessments, ensuring that employees are equipped with the required knowledge and skills for effective governance. • During the **Rozgar Mela**, newly recruited personnel can leverage iGOT Karmayogi alongside formal skill programs to enhance their professional capabilities.
